scripts.deploy: node --input-type=module --eval "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.mahayana-distribution/mahayana/plugin.json', 'utf8')); const version = manifest.version.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); const name = 'mahayana-market-hello-' + version + '-' + manifest.packageSha256.slice(0, 8); const result = spawnSync('npx', ['--yes', 'wrangler@4', 'deploy', '--name', name], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
